area_note: Hanoi, from Hoan Kiem Lake and the old quarter out to lakeside and park neighbourhoods such as Hoang Mai, Thanh Tri and Long Bien
intro: Hanoi's runners gather around the city's lakes and parks. At Hoan Kiem Lake (Ho Guom), Chay365 has held a Saturday dawn long run for more than 225 weeks. Neighbourhood groups run at Den Lu Lake, Hoang Cau Lake and Hoa Binh Park and in housing areas such as Thanh Ha. Most group runs start early, from about 5am, and some groups add evening sessions from around 6pm. The hash leaves the city by bus on Saturday afternoons for countryside trails. Much of the scene organises through Facebook groups, Zalo and Strava clubs, often tied to one lake, park or housing area.

clubs.name: Chay365

meets.where: Hoan Kiem Lake (Ho Guom) pedestrian area, Hoan Kiem

clubs.description: A Hanoi running community and website founded in 2014. Its weekly Saturday dawn long run around Hoan Kiem Lake has a volunteer water station and pacers, and a photo diary is posted after each week. It sometimes holds joint runs with other clubs.
clubs.active_evidence: Weekly long-run diaries on chay365.com; week 228 (run on Saturday 24 Oct 2026) posted 26 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Hanoi Hash House Harriers (Traditional Hanoi H3)

meets.when: Saturdays, bus leaves 1:30pm in winter (from 10 Oct 2026) and 2:00pm in summer
meets.where: Pick-up at 8 Hai Ba Trung, Hoan Kiem; trails in the countryside outside Hanoi

meets.when: Occasional Thursday evening runs, about every two weeks

clubs.cost: VND 200,000 for first-timers (includes transport, drinks and snacks at the circle); city runs VND 50,000 for women and VND 100,000 for men; children under 5 free
clubs.who: All ages and fitness levels; runners and walkers
clubs.description: A hash kennel, running since 1991, that takes a bus out of the city every Saturday, rain or shine. Trails run through villages, rice fields and hills, with walking (about 6 km) and running (about 8 km) options, followed by a beer circle.
clubs.active_evidence: Website upcoming run: No. 1840, Saturday 7 Nov 2026

clubs.name: The Hanoi Run Club (THRC)

meets.when: Weekly runs announced on Strava and WhatsApp (e.g. weekday night runs, Sunday social runs)
meets.where: Often Hoang Cau Lake, Dong Da

clubs.description: A social run club whose tagline is 'Thrive through miles, ends with vibe and matcha'. It has about 950 Strava members and posts announcements for night runs, tempo runs and Sunday social runs.
clubs.active_evidence: Club announcements on Strava: night run 3 Jun 2026, 7 km tempo run at Hoang Cau Lake 10 Jun 2026, Sunday Social Run #4 (15 Jun 2026), Recovery Night Run #3 (18 Jun 2026)

clubs.name: Red River Runners
clubs.description: A Hanoi-based road and trail running group with regular weekday and weekend runs. It also has a Facebook page (Red River Runners Hanoi).
clubs.active_evidence: Member post on the Strava club page, 4 May 2026 (member-authored; little club activity visible on Strava)

clubs.name: Den Lu Lake Running Community (Cộng đồng chạy bộ hồ Đền Lừ)
clubs.who: Open to all ages and genders
clubs.description: A neighbourhood running community, formed in October 2019, whose members run together at Den Lu Lake and share training experience. It has about 790 Strava members and also organises through a Facebook group and a members-only Zalo group.
clubs.active_evidence: New-member post on the Strava club page, 23 Jul 2026; club's sixth-anniversary post, Oct 2025

clubs.name: HBPR – Hoa Binh Park Runners
clubs.description: A group for people who run in Hoa Binh Park and their friends. Events, challenges and discussion happen in the club's Facebook group.
clubs.active_evidence: Member post on the Strava club page, 12 Jun 2026 (member-authored)

clubs.name: THR – Thanh Ha Runners
clubs.description: The running community of the Thanh Ha urban area in Thanh Tri, with about 170 Strava members who train together and share running knowledge.
clubs.active_evidence: Member posts on the Strava club page, Jan, Jun and 13 Sep 2026

coaches.name: Linh Academy (PBRUN Academy) – Coach Đỗ Trọng Linh
coaches.offers: Online courses ('Chạy Bộ Đúng Cách' running technique, and a knee-health course) with weekly group Zoom Q&A and a Zalo support group; 1:1 coaching with personalised plans sent to the runner's watch, Zalo support and weekly 1:1 Zoom calls
coaches.where: Online (Zoom and Zalo); company based at 9 Duy Tan, Cau Giay, Hanoi
coaches.credentials: V.O2 Distance Running Coach certificate (Jack Daniels' VDOT O2)
coaches.description: A Hanoi-registered coaching company (PBRUN Academy) run by Đỗ Trọng Linh, who also founded the Happyrun running store in Cau Giay. Coaching is delivered online and built around heart-rate and VDOT-based plans, for beginners through to marathon and trail runners.
coaches.active_evidence: Training articles in the site's Kiến Thức section dated 15 Oct to 1 Nov 2026

coaches.name: VietMarathoners
coaches.offers: Long-term, goal-based and weight-loss coaching packages with workouts delivered through TrainingPeaks, a weekly long run with a coach and pacer, and 1:1 Q&A; 1:1 in-person sessions; packages for companies and clubs; pacers for races
coaches.where: Saturdays 5–7am at the Starlake urban area, Hanoi (in-person sessions)
coaches.credentials: Co-founder Hiếu Phùng holds a UESCA running coach certificate (Jun 2023)
coaches.description: A Hanoi running knowledge site and coaching team that writes training plans for individual goals, from first 5Ks to ultramarathons. Runners based in Hanoi can join the coaches in person on Saturday mornings.
coaches.active_evidence: Article on a corporate team's training under VietMarathoners coaches, 30 Oct 2026
